title: Evolver: Chain-of-Evolution Prompting to Boost Large Multimodal Models for Hateful Meme Detection

bias_targets.methodology: Zero-shot binary classification of image-text pairs (memes) evaluated using Accuracy and AUC on the Multimedia Automatic Misogyny Identification (MAMI) dataset, which tests for misogynous, sexist, and objectifying content.

bias_targets.target: Multidimensional Hate Speech (Race, Ethnicity, Religion, Sexual Orientation, Disability, Nationality)
bias_targets.methodology: Evaluating zero-shot classification performance (Accuracy and AUC) on the Facebook Hateful Meme (FHM) dataset, which measures detection of multimodal attacks against various protected demographic groups.

Evaluating zero-shot binary classification of potentially harmful multi-modal content using the Harmful Meme (HarM) dataset, focusing on memes that can cause harm to individuals, organizations, or society.
